releases.notes:
### Changed
- Updated Lighten Up, Chunks! for Minecraft 26.1.2.
- Updated Fabric Loader, Fabric API, Loom, Gradle, and Java toolchain support.
- `/luc start` now defaults to scanning the whole current world/dimension when no explicit selection is configured.
- `/luc preview` and `/luc estimate` also default to the whole current world/dimension.

### Added
- Added `/luc estimate` as an alias for `/luc preview`.
- Added `/luc config get <key>` for checking individual config values.
- Added clearer diagnostics showing the exact region folder checked when no chunks are found.

### Fixed
- Fixed world/dimension region scanning by using Minecraft’s own storage API.
- Fixed Minecraft 26.1.2 API compatibility issues for `ChunkPos`, GUI rendering, and boss bars.
- Fixed command feedback so broadcast-to-ops behavior is respected.
- Fixed radius/region selections binding to the current dimension.

releases.notes:
Initial public release of Lighten Up, Chunks!

This release adds bulk relighting for existing chunks on Fabric 1.21.11, aimed at repairing broken or missing saved light data in explored worlds. It supports whole-world, region, and radius scans, configurable progress display, Mod Menu config support, and client update syncing so corrected lighting is visible without waiting for chunks to naturally cycle back in.

Highlights:
- Bulk relight existing chunks
- World, region, and radius processing modes
- Chunky-style command workflow
- Boss bar progress display
- Mod Menu config screen
- Saved-light repair workflow for Voxy and similar tools

Example commands:
- /luc start
- /luc start region <x1> <z1> <x2> <z2>
- /luc start radius <radius> <x> <z>
- /luc status
- /luc config
